name: Field Rest in the Dark Halls
read_aloud: Field rest outside a certified saferoom. Quiet is not guaranteed. Rest-without-saferoom fee applies where posted.
narrator_line: Field rest outside a certified saferoom.
layout: Wherever the party camps outside a saferoom: dark halls, red emergency light, a place with a door they can close.

features.name: Red dim light; Ceiling Ticks interrupt a field rest per 00-overview.md section 2 rule 7. A field rest can only be a Short Rest.

enemies.note: spoken_name is the live Day-page name. stat_card is the SRD body in this pack. Dean Thudd is not renamed.

quick_run.setup: Dark halls and red light; the party is far from the Green Room and tired.
quick_run.decision: Pay for a quiet field rest (a Short Rest only), or push back to the Green Room?
quick_run.on_success: A quiet Short Rest is bought and the day's Long Rest waits at the Green Room.
quick_run.on_failure: Ceiling Ticks interrupt the rest and spoil it.
quick_run.cut_short: Skip the camp description and roll once for the interruption.

gm_notes: Strong-model notes stay on the Day page. This stub does not copy if_they_do_something_dumb.
